title: The Forgotten Sigil Again
author: Paloma Oyelaran
blurb: Edmund Eastwick, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
